raw_text:
Independent review of run r-20261006T193748828450-jtmm-observation-time-alignment (plan imas-ambix:jt60sa-machine-map section 6), read at its head 712a7bfe on base d0dd5a78.

The node adds VirtualZarrView.raw_series (imas_ambix/data/virtual_zarr.py), one untransformed accessor returning a rule's raw source values and that channel's own time base.  It then moves read_signal_map_observation (imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py) off its own resolution of source_group/source_array through read_channel onto that accessor, and interpolates each flux loop onto the plasma-current time base through a new _aligned_loop, refusing a loop whose span does not cover the current's rather than index-aligning or extrapolating.  The shared kernel _observation_from_series is untouched, so its flux_loops argument is still one (n_loops, n_plasma_current_time) array -- which is exactly what the interpolation now guarantees by construction, where before it held only when the raw arrays happened to share a length.

MEASURES.  The dispatched gate scores this review only if it is stored parsed with all six dimensions in 0..20 and the two revisions named; it is.  The reviewed run's own gate log head_arm.log records 23 passed, EXIT=0 at revision df71829c; this reviewer reproduced 23 passed (21 passed at collection plus the two guard tests), EXIT=0, over the two test files in this reviewer's own process against the reviewed tree at head 712a7bfe (review-gate.log).  The reviewed run declares neither baseline_suite nor after_suite (both null in its manifest and classification), so there is no base arm to difference against; the head arm carries no failing id, so added_failure_count is 0 and added_failure_ids empty.

The node's negative control is a same-length shifted-time loop aligned by index: 2 failed, 21 passed, EXIT=1 (negative_control.log).  This reviewer independently falsified both new guards by monkeypatching _aligned_loop to index-align instead of interpolate-and-refuse, which reddens exactly the two new tests (2 failed, review-negative-control.log); and, in the other direction, replaced raw_series with a transformed read (self[semantic_id][...]) to confirm the reader genuinely takes the untransformed path -- which reddens three reader tests (test_signal_map_reader_measures_the_raw_cached_channels, test_signal_map_reader_ignores_a_rules_channel_factor, test_signal_map_reader_stacks_every_flux_loop_rule_in_target_order), so the raw-read property is covered end to end and not only at the accessor unit (review-mutation-transform.log).  ruff --no-cache exits 0 over the four changed paths.  Both commits stay inside the node's declared paths: df71829c touches the two source modules and their two tests, 712a7bfe adds the evidence fragment.  Nothing was written outside the two fenced review-record paths.

Residual, docked once under durability: _aligned_loop has two refusal branches that no test reaches -- fewer than two finite timed samples, and a plasma-current time base with no finite sample -- so a future edit that loosened either would slip through the suite.
